# Slipreel

> Slipreel is a macOS screen recorder and editor that turns a raw screen capture into a polished product demo. The moment you stop recording it automatically zooms in on your clicks, smooths the cursor path, wraps the footage in a device frame on a background, and can transcribe captions on-device — then exports to MP4 or GIF.

Slipreel is a native macOS app (macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon or Intel), signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, distributed directly from slipreel.app (not the Mac App Store). It is made by Becoming Ventures, LLC. The app is free to download and fully functional for recording and editing; the current release includes three free full-quality exports, then a paid license unlocks unlimited exports.

Privacy: recording, editing, captions, and export run on the user's Mac. Slipreel does not upload recording media; users can export and share their files themselves. Network connections include license activation and renewal, update checks, and the first caption-model download (roughly 488 MB). Optional usage analytics, diagnostics, and submitted feedback can also send data. Usage events use a random session identifier before sign-in and may be associated with the account identifier while signed in. See the privacy policy for details.

## Who it is for

- Founders, product and marketing teams, developer advocates, educators, and support teams
- Anyone making product demos, tutorials, or feature walkthroughs on a Mac who wants a finished, edited-looking video without opening a full video editor

## Features

- Automatic zoom: detects every click and pushes in on it, anticipating cursor movement; each zoom is an editable timeline region, and you can add your own
- Cursor smoothing: smooths the cursor path, adds motion blur, and highlights clicks, keeping timing honest through sped-up cuts
- Device frames: wrap the recording in an iPhone or iPad bezel, or a macOS window frame, over a wallpaper or solid-color background, with adjustable padding, corners, and aspect ratio
- Keystroke overlays: records what you typed and renders it on its own timeline lane; any keystroke can be muted
- On-device captions: the Whisper transcription engine ships inside the app and runs locally; the speech model downloads once on first use and is cached; edit the text and burn it in on export
- Audio: microphone and system audio captured as independent tracks, mixed down on export
- Camera: record a webcam track alongside the screen, kept in sync
- Timeline editing: split at the playhead (Cmd+K), with per-slice trim and speed, snapping to clicks and zoom edges; waveforms render in the slice
- Capture modes: full display, a single window, or a region
- Export: MP4 and GIF, in six aspect ratios; the preview and export run the same canvas math, so what you approve is what ships
- Also: 3-2-1 countdown, pause/resume, global hotkeys, 3D tilt, zoom movements, crash recovery, duration warnings, automatic signed updates

## Pricing

- Monthly: $9/month
- One-time purchase: $69 once. Includes one year of updates; unlimited exports continue with versions released during that year. Later updates are an optional paid renewal.
- Both paid plans cover two Macs and require an internet connection at least every 14 days to renew activation.
- Three full-quality exports are free, with no account or credit card. Recording and editing have no time limit.
- 14-day refund: email hello@slipreel.app

## Limits

- macOS only; no Windows or Linux release
- Exports local MP4 or GIF files; no built-in cloud video hosting or instant share links
- GIF export is limited to 60 seconds of edited content
- Captions run offline after the initial model download; paid licensing still needs periodic internet access
